gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.

gaps.explanation: The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
